Try weighted pool_full softmax_neg_error. Or weighted pool4 softmax_neg_error. We have only one left. Best to try weighted pool4 softmax_neg_error.

attempts.rationale: trend_dominated, ranking unstable → test a simple robust mean over all models.
test a weighted combination using inverse_error on the full model pool to see if giving more weight to lower‑error models improves over the mean.
test a robust weighted scheme with softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over mean pool4.
ranking is unstable and the series is trend‑dominated, so a robust median over all models may outperform mean.
Test a robust trimmed mean over the full pool to reduce influence of outlier models in this trend‑dominated series with unstable rankings.
Try a weighted combination on the robust pool4 using inverse_error to see if focusing on the strongest trend‑dominated models improves over the mean.
Try a DBA combination over the stable pool4 to see if iterative refinement beats the simple mean on that subset, given trend dominance and unstable rankings.
test a weighted combination on the stable pool4 using softmax_neg_error to see if a different weighting improves over the mean pool4 baseline.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9541. Series context: trend strength 0.8687 and seasonal strength 0.1759; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.285.
